title: Beam search with length normalization
hints: Keep `live` as a list of (tokens, total log-prob). Each round expands every live hypothesis with every next token, sorts all candidates by total log-prob and keeps the best beam_width.
A kept candidate whose last token is eos moves to `finished` and is never expanded again. Stop when nothing is live or after max_len rounds; whatever is still live then counts as finished too.
Rank candidates inside a round by the raw total (they all have the same length); compare finished hypotheses by logp / n ** alpha with n the number of generated tokens.
